preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output sequence has exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] >= output[i-1] for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: The output sequence is lexicographically maximum.

invariants.expression: output[i] == gcd(input[:i+1]) for i in range(n)
invariants.description: The ith element of the output is the GCD of the first i+1 elements of the input.
